_metadata.comparison_note: Design-characteristic comparison only — NOT experimental performance. Tools use different chemistries (HG Lab uses Chen 2005 stem-loop RT-qPCR; miRprimer/miPrimer use linear RT primers). Compares in-silico design metrics only (Tm, GC%, structure delta-G, predicted specificity, design success rate, speed). Wet-lab PCR efficiency comparison requires self-generated calibration data (see calibration/calibration_data_requirement.md).

limitations: Different RT chemistries (stem-loop vs linear) make direct efficiency comparison invalid
miRprimer / miPrimer columns are N/A (binary not installed); comparison is HG Lab only
Panel of 50 curated open-access hsa- miRNAs — may not represent full biological diversity
Design time includes network overhead (localhost); actual server latency will differ
_metadata.validation_note: Competitor columns are null (different RT chemistry / binaries not installed); scientific correctness is established by the `validation` block: 2439/2439 checks vs Chen 2005 deterministic ground truth + Wang 2017 specificity concordance. Includes a BYTE-IDENTICAL exact match of the miR-16 stem-loop RT primer + universal reverse to a published table, plus cross-system RT-overhang/forward concordance with Czimmerer 2013 (miR-1, miR-181a) and Yang 2014 (miR-150) — independent labs using different universal stem-loop bodies.

validation.purpose: Independent scientific validation of the design engine against published-methodology ground truth AND real published primer tables: one byte-identical exact match (same universal system) plus cross-system RT-overhang & forward concordance from independent labs/chemistries.
validation.method: Deterministic ground truth from the Chen 2005 stem-loop method (RT primer = fixed universal body + revcomp of 3'-terminal 6 nt; universal reverse = fixed constant; forward specific region = 5' prefix of the miRNA), recomputed independently from the sequence the tool used. Plus thermodynamic-plausibility windows and let-7 specificity concordance with Wang 2017.
